weapons.name: Px4 Storm full-size .40 S&W
weapons.source_note: Beretta Px4 Storm instruction manual, SPECIFICATIONS AND TECHNICAL DATA: "Rifling Pitch (in./mm) ... .40 S&W 15.75 / 400" and "Rifling R.H., 6 grooves." States the .40 S&W barrel has a right-hand 15.75 in (400 mm) rifling pitch with 6 grooves. Barrel length 4.02 in / 102 mm.

weapons.name: CZ 455 American rimfire bolt-action, American walnut, 20.67" barrel
weapons.source_note: CZ-USA CZ 455 American 22 LR product page: "Ammunition .22 LR" and "Rate of Twist 1:16 in", "Barrel Length 20.500 in". States a 1 turn in 16 inch twist for the .22 LR barrel = 406.4 mm per turn. CZUB's Czech catalogue for the same model confirms ".22 LR (16")".

weapons.name: CZ 455 Varmint rimfire bolt-action, heavy bull barrel
weapons.source_note: CZUB CZ 455 Varmint catalogue page (English): "Caliber (rate of twist) .22 LR (16")" and "Barrel length 525 mm". States a 1 turn in 16 inch twist for the .22 LR Varmint barrel = 406.4 mm per turn.

weapons.name: CZ 512 semi-automatic rimfire, .22 LR
weapons.source_note: CZ-USA CZ 512 Semi-Automatic 22 LR product page: "Twist Rate Choose an option 1:16 in", "Barrel Length Choose an option 20.5 in". States a 1 turn in 16 inch twist for the .22 LR barrel = 406.4 mm per turn.

weapons.name: CZ 527 Varmint mini-Mauser bolt-action, heavy barrel, Kevlar stock
weapons.source_note: CZUB CZ 527 Varmint catalogue page (English): "Calibre - detacheable magazine (rate of twist) .223 Rem. (12")" and "Barrel length 650 mm". States a 1 turn in 12 inch twist for the .223 Remington Varmint barrel = 304.8 mm per turn.

weapons.name: CZ 550 American Mauser 98 bolt-action, .30-06 American walnut
weapons.source_note: CZUB CZ 550 American catalogue page: "Raze - schranka (stoupani dražek) .308 Win. (10") / .30-06 Sprg. (10")" and "Delka hlavne 600 mm". States a 1 turn in 10 inch twist (stoupani dražek) for the .30-06 Springfield barrel = 254.0 mm per turn.

weapons.name: .450 Bushmaster Semi-auto Rifle
weapons.source_note: Bushmaster 450 Bushmaster 20" product page specifications: "- Barrel Length: 20" ... - Twist Rate: 1:24". States a 1 turn in 24 inch twist = 609.6 mm per turn. The separate Bushmaster 20" .450 Bushmaster Barrel page also states "has a twist rate of 1:24".

weapons.name: Dissipator Semi-auto Rifle
weapons.source_note: Bushmaster XM-15 Rifles User Manual: "Barrels on XM15 and Carbon 15 Models are either chrome lined Chrome Moly Vanadium Steel or 416 Stainless Steel. They are usually button rifled 1 turn in 9" with a right hand twist - 6 lands and grooves." The Dissipator is an XM15 E2S 16" carbine variant, so the XM-15 barrel specification 1 turn in 9 inch = 228.6 mm per turn applies.

weapons.name: M17S Semi-auto Bullpup Rifle
weapons.source_note: Bushmaster M17S Bullpup Rifle catalogue page specification table: "Caliber .223 Rem.", "Barrel Length 21.5 inches", "Rifling R.H. twist;1 turn in 9"". The FAQ page for the same rifle states "Rifling: 6 grooves / R.H. twist / 1 turn in 9 inches". States a right-hand 1 turn in 9 inch twist with 6 grooves = 228.6 mm per turn.

weapons.name: XM-15 A3G Semi-auto Rifle
weapons.source_note: Bushmaster XM-15 Rifles User Manual: "Barrels on XM15 and Carbon 15 Models are either chrome lined Chrome Moly Vanadium Steel or 416 Stainless Steel. They are usually button rifled 1 turn in 9" with a right hand twist - 6 lands and grooves." States the XM-15 barrel twist is 1 turn in 9 inch with 6 lands and grooves = 228.6 mm per turn.

weapons.name: XM-15 A4G Semi-auto Rifle
weapons.source_note: Bushmaster XM-15 Rifles User Manual: "Barrels on XM15 and Carbon 15 Models are either chrome lined Chrome Moly Vanadium Steel or 416 Stainless Steel. They are usually button rifled 1 turn in 9" with a right hand twist - 6 lands and grooves." States the XM-15 barrel twist is 1 turn in 9 inch with 6 lands and grooves = 228.6 mm per turn.

weapons.name: XM-15 DMR Semi-auto Rifle
weapons.source_note: Bushmaster XM-15 Rifles User Manual: "Barrels on XM15 and Carbon 15 Models are either chrome lined Chrome Moly Vanadium Steel or 416 Stainless Steel. They are usually button rifled 1 turn in 9" with a right hand twist - 6 lands and grooves." The DMR is an XM-15 model, so the XM-15 barrel specification 1 turn in 9 inch = 228.6 mm per turn applies.

weapons.name: CDX-40 Shadow .375 CheyTac
weapons.source_note: Cadex Defence CDX-40 SHDW product page specification: "Caliber: 375 CT / Barrel Length: 32″ / Barrel type: Bartlein / Twist rate: 1:7″". The page describes the CDX-40 SHDW as chambered in 375 EnABELR or 375/408 CT. States a 1 turn in 7 inch twist = 177.8 mm per turn. All Cadex barrels are stated as 5R rifling.

weapons.name: CDX-Lite Tremor .308 Winchester
weapons.source_note: Cadex Defence CDX-Lite Series specification table: "308 Win ... 20" / 24" / 26" 1:11¼" or (1:10") 5R". States the .308 Win chambering is offered with a 1 turn in 11¼ inch twist or 1 turn in 10 inch twist, 5R rifling. Recorded value is the first-listed 1:11¼ inch = 285.75 mm per turn. The alternate option is 1:10 = 254.0 mm per turn.
